map.在线文本换行与填充工具，按指定宽度对段落自动折行，或向每行填充前缀/后缀至固定长: An online text wrapping and padding tool that breaks paragraphs automatically at a given width or pads every line with a prefix or suffix to a fixed length, suitable for code comments and aligned typesetting, processed purely in the front end.
map.字符模式：行数 = ⌈文本长度 / 宽度⌉，第 i 行 = 文本[i×宽度 :: Character mode: line count = ⌈text length / width⌉, and line i = text[i×width : (i+1)×width]; word mode: split on whitespace and wrap once the accumulated length exceeds the width; over-long words (word length > width) are force-split at the width
map.字符模式严格按定长切分，会切断英文单词与中文词语，适合固定宽度设备（如小票、终端: Character mode splits strictly at a fixed length and can cut English words and Chinese terms, so it suits fixed-width devices such as receipts and terminals. Word mode keeps words intact at the cost of slightly more lines and better readability, and is the default for body text. Both modes count UTF-16 code units, so emoji or surrogate pairs (such as 𝕏 or some emoji) inflate the count; visual width follows actual rendering. The line break can be a newline, a Windows carriage return pair or a br tag: use the br tag for HTML fragments and the Windows pair for Windows text.
